series_start_reason: GSK prints Benlysta in its turnover tables from Q1 2012 (the 2011 releases mention it only in narrative: Q2 2011 sales GBP 2m and full-year 2011 GBP 15m, no per-quarter table rows). The series starts at 2012Q4, the first full quarter after GSK acquired Human Genome Sciences on 3 August 2012: before that, GSK's US Benlysta turnover was only its share of gross profit (Q1 2012 release 0001191638-12-000550: 'GSK turnover of GBP 9 million in the quarter reflects the share of gross profit in the US and total sales in all other markets'); the Q3 2012 release (0001191638-12-001390) splits Q3 2012 into GBP 16m of US sales after the acquisition, GBP 3m of US turnover before it representing the share of gross profit, and GBP 1m Europe. 2012Q1-2012Q3 (9, 12, 20) are therefore a different scope and are excluded.
notes: Worldwide Group turnover from GSK's pharmaceuticals turnover table (Total column; US/Europe/International printed beside it). From 2012Q4 the line is full Benlysta sales in all markets (US sales booked by GSK after the HGS acquisition). The brand total is one line; GSK does not print the intravenous and subcutaneous formulations separately and the cited tables do not date when the subcutaneous formulation entered the line. Q1 2012 release quote: 'Benlysta for lupus has now been launched in the US and most European markets'; no cited document states the launch quarter, so launch_quarter is null. Currency GBP, as printed.
search_log: Bigdata.com smart search ('GSK Benlysta turnover third quarter 2021', filings) returned no chunks for GSK Q3 2021; document discovery therefore done directly on EDGAR.
listed GSK (CIK 0001131399) filings via data.sec.gov submissions incl. paginated older files, all form types (6-K, 6-K/A, 20-F counted); 6,839 filings listed

2012-2026: selected 6-Ks whose primaryDocDescription matches 1ST/2ND/3RD QUARTER RESULTS, HALF-YEAR(LY) REPORT, FINAL RESULTS (the 2022-02-07 'PUBLICATION OF FULL YEAR 2021 RESULTS' 6-K was skipped in favour of the 2022-02-09 FINAL RESULTS 6-K); 2008-2011: results 6-Ks identified by hand from filings in the late-Jan/Feb, late-Apr, late-Jul and late-Oct windows (descriptions are generic 'FORM 6-K'/'6-K'); 2010-09-10 'historical quarterly turnover by product' 6-K not used as a source, each quarter is read from its own results announcement

fetched each main document from sec.gov Archives and parsed table rows; the product's regional turnover rows (Total, growth %, US, Europe, International where printed) were taken: Q1 release first such row; Q2/Q3 releases first row = quarter, second = year-to-date; Q4 release first row = full year, second row = fourth quarter
arithmetic check run on every year: Q1+Q2 = printed six-month row, +Q3 = printed nine-month row, +Q4 = printed full-year row; no mismatch beyond rounding found

Benlysta rows found in every results release 2012Q1-2026Q2 (58 quarters); 2012Q1-Q3 excluded for the gross-profit-share scope described in series_start_reason; 2011 releases (0001191638-11 Q3: 0001193125-11-281704; Q4: 0001193125-12-043398) checked: no table row, narrative only
